verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a self-serve export of all account data in open formats, and it describes no offboarding or leave flow. The closest item is a custom-reports API endpoint whose output format and scope are unstated. That API is also restricted to App Integration and Embedded Payroll partners, so it is at best an adjacent developer building block rather than a user-facing full data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
